content.rendered:
Holiday Party DJ – San Jose Hilton Hotel – 12/12/13

Company Parties for IBN – Insurance Brokers Network Party,
we have been DJing  this party for 7 years now.The first party started in Dublin, CA.


lots of Dancing, American, Latin, some arabic.

 


Gobo Snowflake Lighting.
